v0.1.17 — fix 'Bottom space' slider (was a no-op in v0.1.16):
- The bottom space is now a real spacer element below the terminal, so the fit recomputes fewer rows and the prompt actually floats above the window's bottom edge. In v0.1.16 the padding approach was ignored by the terminal fit, so the slider had no visible effect.
- Slider lives in the sidebar View section (0–400px, default 80); set 0 for edge-to-edge.
